# Font pairing / type style

**What typefaces and colour accents do titles and labels use?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## Clean sans, red/green coding
<a id="clean-sans-teaching"></a>

Inter or SF Pro style, white and yellow on dark; red means wrong, green means right.

**Looks like:** Plain white labels, a green tick on the right way and a red cross on the wrong. Nothing decorative; it reads like a good app.

**Good at:** clarity; teaching; fast to make

**Weak at:** generic; little personality

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, yt-short · niches tech, gym, all · goals saves, trust · effort low

**How:** The system sans in Edits/CapCut, or Inter in HyperFrames, with two accent colours.

**Backed by:** [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching), [Plain shadowed captions, no box](../topics/text.md#l10-plain-shadow-captions), [Extended bold sans titles, neon highlights](../topics/text.md#text-extended-sans-neon), [Script + heavy extruded sans pairing](../topics/text.md#text-script-plus-heavy-sans) · sources L01, R1, L10

## Serif accent plus sans body
<a id="serif-plus-sans"></a>

Emphasis words or section titles in a serif (italic or bold yellow), body in clean sans.

**Looks like:** 'Looks *pro*.' with 'pro' in serif italic, and yellow serif section titles between parts. It feels editorial and a bit premium.

**Good at:** premium feel; emphasis; travel and lifestyle

**Weak at:** two fonts to manage; serifs get thin on small screens

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, carousel, yt-long · niches travel, all · goals trust, saves · effort low

**How:** Instrument Serif Italic plus Inter in HyperFrames; Edits/CapCut have similar serif options.

**Backed by:** [Serif italic emphasis + sans body](../topics/text.md#text-serif-italic-emphasis), [Yellow bold serif section titles](../topics/text.md#text-yellow-serif-section-titles), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching), [Script + heavy extruded sans pairing](../topics/text.md#text-script-plus-heavy-sans) · sources L02, L06, KH

## Extended wide sans, neon highlights
<a id="extended-neon"></a>

Extended bold geometric titles (Druk Wide or Monument Extended style), Inter body, cyan, lime and pink on numbers.

**Looks like:** Wide heavy 'ROAS' fills the width; numbers glow cyan and lime on black. It feels like a tech launch.

**Good at:** bold brand look; numbers pop; tech and gaming fit

**Weak at:** can look loud; needs a dark grade

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long, carousel · niches tech, gaming · goals reach, retention · effort medium

**How:** A free extended display font plus Inter in HyperFrames; CapCut has a wide display font.

**Backed by:** [Extended bold sans titles, neon highlights](../topics/text.md#text-extended-sans-neon), [Script + heavy extruded sans pairing](../topics/text.md#text-script-plus-heavy-sans), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching), [Yellow bold serif section titles](../topics/text.md#text-yellow-serif-section-titles) · sources L07

## Brush script plus heavy extruded sans
<a id="script-plus-heavy"></a>

Brush-script accents paired with a heavy condensed or extruded sans, red and cyan palette.

**Looks like:** 'If I have to make' in script, then '$100,000/MONTH' in heavy caps with glow and chromatic aberration. It feels like a hype trailer.

**Good at:** energy; teasers; gym hype

**Weak at:** can feel dated or loud; hard to read when small

**Best for:** formats reel30, yt-short · niches gym, gaming · goals reach · effort medium

**How:** Montserrat ExtraBold plus a free brush script; glow via CapCut effects or a HyperFrames filter.

**Backed by:** [Script + heavy extruded sans pairing](../topics/text.md#text-script-plus-heavy-sans), [Teaching text: clean sans, red/green](../topics/text.md#text-clean-sans-teaching), [Extended bold sans titles, neon highlights](../topics/text.md#text-extended-sans-neon), [High contrast, deep blacks, neon accents](../topics/colour.md#colour-neon-high-contrast) · sources L08

## Heavy condensed caps labels, one accent
<a id="condensed-caps-labels"></a>

1–3 word all-caps condensed labels in a single brand accent (Rahul's yellow) on black boxes; big ₹ figures with shadow.

**Looks like:** 'WI-FI OFF', 'HEATER', '₹46,000' pop over the chest in yellow on black. Instantly recognisable as one creator's look.

**Good at:** brand recognition; readability at a glance; price and number emphasis

**Weak at:** shouty if overused; one look for everything

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gaming, gym · goals reach, follows · effort low

**How:** Bebas or Oswald style caps in Edits/CapCut with a black box; one brand hex for every label.

**Backed by:** [Yellow caps labels and big ₹ figures](../topics/text.md#text-yellow-condensed-labels), [Near-black with one accent colour](../topics/colour.md#colour-near-black-one-accent), [Template card type: badge + hand-lettered text, yellow blanks](../topics/text.md#l11-template-card-typography), [Plain shadowed captions, no box](../topics/text.md#l10-plain-shadow-captions) · sources R1, L10

## Mixing
Most sources pair one display face with a clean sans body. Condensed caps labels plus clean sans captions is Rahul's combo; serif emphasis plus sans is L02 and the Khandala reel.

## Rule of thumb
Teaching: clean sans. Travel and premium: serif plus sans. Tech brand look: extended neon or condensed caps. Hype teasers: script plus heavy.
